module: Flowgraph node "Planet" (category once_p_duration, vehicle color/icon). Gives a vehicle planetary gravity (obj:setPlanets with position, radius and mass) and also generates a real solid planet: six procedural mesh faces (ProceduralMesh) deformed into a sphere from a cube-cross PNG height map (default "cubemap_small.png"), placed at the given position, with a "procheightmapMat" material created on the fly. Inputs: vehId (otherwise player), position (vec3), heightmap (PNG path), surfaceHeight (relief scale, 1 by default), radius (≥ 1), mass. On stop or reset, removes the vehicle's planets and deletes the created objects. The game notes that documentation of the parameters is missing.
notes: Game C.todo: "Needs further documentation on what each parameter does and how it should be used."
workOnce does nothing if position, radius or mass is nil or if |radius| < 1; does not check that the vehicle exists (nil veh crashes).
The local function `test` (end of the file) references M which does not exist in this file and is never called.
warpSphere (unused by workOnce) is an old version; workOnce uses warpSphereCubic.
Old pin renamed: vehID -> vehId. Constant C.gConst = 6.6742e-11.
In the editor, data.showDebug (true) draws the sphere, the mass, the force and the distance in drawMiddle.

C.desc: Node class, with the planet generation functions.

onNodeReset.desc: Removes the vehicle's planets (obj:setPlanets({})) and deletes the created ProceduralMesh objects.

workOnce.desc: Applies planetary gravity to the vehicle, creates the material, loads the height map, generates the six faces of the planet and reloads collisions (be:reloadCollision).

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: debug drawing and surface gravity (G*mass/radius²).

createheightmapMesh.desc: Builds the mesh data (vertices, UVs, smoothed normals, faces, material) from a grid of points with a border.

warpSphere.desc: Deforms a flat grid into a spherical cap (angular method, unused by workOnce).

warpSphereCubic.desc: Projects a cube face onto a sphere of given radius, with relief = z * surfaceHeight.

normalFromPoints.desc: Normal (positive z) of triangle p1, p3, p2.

placeObject.desc: Creates an unsaved ProceduralMesh in MissionGroup with the given mesh, position and rotation.

heightmapFromPNG.desc: Loads a PNG (GBitmap) and returns a grid of vec3(x, y, z) where z = average brightness 0-1 (sign inverted by default).

invertColors.desc: if true, positive z instead of negative

getSquare.desc: Extracts from the cross map the requested cube face (f, r, b, l, u, d), with a one-point border copied from the neighboring faces (blLookup table), and scales the x/y coordinates to the dimensions.

identifier.desc: face: f, r, b, l, u or d
